title: Noon
overview:
NOON, a versus action game with a whole new feel

A dramatic action game where the lives of 6 warriors intersect!

Each of the 6 protagonists has their own story. Holding feelings in their hearts that words cannot express, the warriors dive into the battle over NOON!!

[Scenario Play]
A rich story woven by the characters. Scenario Play!
The player chooses one of the 6 characters and fights to the death against rival characters. Along the way, the Four Heavenly Kings lie in wait, summoning giant robots and unleashing a variety of attacks!

[4P Versus]
Up to 4 players can battle. Heated versus play!
Along with 2P head-to-head play, 4P versus is possible using the Multi Terminal 6. The fierce battles you can't get in Scenario Play are right here!

新感覚の対戦型アクションゲームNOON

6戦士の生きざまが交錯するドラマティカルアクションゲーム！

６人の主人公にそれぞれの物語。戦士たちは語り尽くせぬ想いを胸に秘め、NOONをめぐる戦いの中へダイブする!!

〔シナリオプレイ〕
キャラ達が織り成す多彩な物語。シナリオプレイ！
プレイヤーは6人のキャラから一人を選択し、ライバルキャラとの死闘を繰り広げる。また、途中には四天王が待ち構え、巨大ロボを召喚し多彩な攻撃を仕掛けてくるぞ！

〔4P対戦〕
最大４人まで対戦可能。白熱の対戦プレイ！
人対人の2P対戦プレイはもちろん、マルチターミナル6を使用すれば4P対戦も可能。シナリオプレイでは味わえない熱い戦いが今ここに！
